name: MPS Ltd
title: MPS Ltd - 532440 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: MPS Q1 FY27 revenue rose 20.4% to INR 224.24 crores and EBITDA rose 53.0% to INR 76.96 crores, with margin at 34.3%.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 20.4% YoY to INR 224.24 crores, while EBITDA grew 53.0% to INR 76.96 crores and margin expanded to 34.3% from 27.0%. Excluding AJE's deliberate pruning, underlying revenue grew 28.4% to INR 198.47 crores with a 32.4% margin. Unbound Medicine was in its first full quarter and drove Education growth, and Corporate Learning margins recovered sharply on a leaner headcount. Management reaffirmed FY27 EBITDA of comfortably above INR 300 crores and framed FY28 targets of about INR 1,500 crores revenue and INR 450 crores EBITDA.

financial_highlights.change: facility drawn for Unbound Medicine acquisition
from 51 days at end of March
from 404 a year ago; 906 in prior quarter per analyst

segments.name: Research Solutions
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 123.23 crores, +13.2% YoY, 55% of total; EBITDA +37.9% with margin at 45.1%. Core growth ex-AJE was 26.3%.

segments.name: Education Solutions
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 73.41 crores, +42.2% YoY and +22.1% QoQ, with EBITDA margin of 35.1%. Growth includes Unbound Medicine's first full quarter.

segments.name: Corporate Learning (Liberate Global)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 27.60 crores, +6.9% YoY; EBITDA +60.7% with margin at 25.3% vs under 17% a year ago. Headcount about 33% lower YoY.

segments.name: AJE (within Research)
segments.commentary: Deliberately shrinking consumer base in author solutions; management says revenue is smaller but more profitable. Pre-Submission Peer Review launched in April 2026 with demand ahead of plan.

segments.name: Unbound Medicine (within Education)
segments.commentary: Monthly run rate about USD 800,000; current EBITDA margin 18-20%, with a target of mid-to-late 20s. Team of 35 people.

guidance_outlook: FY27 EBITDA expected to comfortably cross INR 300 crores, described as a floor; implies roughly 21% three-year EBITDA CAGR from FY24.
FY28 targets of about INR 1,500 crores revenue and around INR 450 crores EBITDA, per Q&A.
Management aspires to Rule of 50 for the full year but declined to promise it every quarter.
Corporate Learning steady-state target: 30% EBITDA margin and organic growth near 12%.
Unbound expected to reach Rule of 40 (mid-to-late 20s EBITDA margin) over time.
capex_capacity: Unbound acquisition financed partly by INR 37.63 crores of borrowings; management sees acquisitions of INR 300-500 crores as doable from cash plus debt, with no equity planned.
Cash generation of about INR 15-18 crores per month cited as first source for M&A.
AJE's US roles fully offshored to India by end of last fiscal year; little US headcount in Q1.
Headcount: Research 2,262 to 2,452; Education 799 to 765 YoY.
demand_pricing: Research market growing 8-9% versus MPS research growth of roughly 15% per management.
Education market growing about 15%; corporate learning market 12-13% versus MPS at 6-7%.
Manuscript acceptance rate of about 52% in controlled work vs industry baseline near 32%.
MPS now second-largest peer-review provider by volume and targets first place by end of this year.
Management says it has pricing power at Unbound and sees room for price increases across parts of its portfolio.
Corporate Learning enterprise engagements approaching USD 1 million; more AI-led wins and new logos in pipeline.

qa_highlights.question: Why have there been management exits and replacements, and how is culture preserved after acquisitions?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a growing talent machine with more internal promotions than prior years; values of excellence, efficiency and empathy plus an ownership mindset are used to integrate acquisitions.

qa_highlights.question: Is the headcount reduction affecting quality as gig and AI workflows expand?
qa_highlights.answer: Soma said Corporate Learning headcount fell about 33% YoY through redundancy removal, a shift to variable gig capacity and productivity gains; senior design and client-facing teams untouched. Rahul said NPS rose in Research and Education.

qa_highlights.question: Why did the client count fall from 906 to 841 QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the only pruning was at AJE, as described on the call.

qa_highlights.question: Is the FY28 target INR 1,500 crores revenue, and how will acquisitions be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: FY28 targets are about INR 1,500 crores revenue and about INR 450 crores EBITDA. Acquisitions of INR 300-500 crores are to be funded by cash accruals and debt; equity not planned. Assets below USD 15 million revenue are generally avoided, with a preference for Education.

qa_highlights.question: What is Unbound's monthly run rate and margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Prarthana said monthly run rate is around USD 800,000 with EBITDA margins of 18-20%, rising from there.

qa_highlights.question: Can organic growth be pushed higher, and does Corporate Learning growth reflect FX?
qa_highlights.answer: Rahul said management aims to outgrow markets in all three segments, targeting late-teens organic growth. On FX, he said North America is a smaller share of Corporate Learning, so dollar tailwind is smaller there.

risks_watch: Corporate Learning organic growth at 6.9% lags its 12-13% market and the stated 12% steady-state target.
Client count fell QoQ to 841 from 906; management attributes this only to AJE pruning.
Unbound margin at 18-20% is below the group level; renewal-cycle and synergy timing are still being learned.
Headcount cuts and gig/associate shift in Corporate Learning need to be watched for quality and client retention.
Acquisition pipeline is active; execution on INR 300-500 crore deals and debt use is a watch item.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on margins, AI and outcome-based revenue, with explicit reaffirmation of the FY27 EBITDA floor. Management was more measured on the Rule of 50 and on organic growth, acknowledging that Corporate Learning and parts of the portfolio are behind market growth.
key_quotes: We continue to expect the Company to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA in FY'27.
Our revenue is steadily shifting from being paid for effort to being paid for outcomes.
The INR 1,500 crores is for FY'28 next year, and that probably will translate to more like INR 450 crores EBITDA.

adds.what: Unbound Medicine acquisition (team of 35, monthly run rate ~USD 800,000) already consolidated; not a new build

growth.why: FY27 EBITDA guided to comfortably cross INR 300 crore (reaffirmed) and FY28 targets of ~INR 1,500 crore revenue and ~INR 450 crore EBITDA, backed by Q1 revenue +20.4% and EBITDA +53%, Unbound consolidation and Corporate Learning margin recovery; no specific new capacity, capex or utilisation figures were given.
